neighbours.label: the second conjunct's distinguishing word in a parallel contrast of two kinds of the same thing ('written French and spoken French', 'the Christian concept and the Jewish concept')
fire: Written English and spoken English follow quite different rules.
The Greek idea of justice and the Roman idea of justice were not the same.
What voters want and what parties offer rarely match.
Classical physics and quantum physics describe the atom differently.
The old method of farming and the new method both have critics.
Indoor cats and outdoor cats face very different risks.
Public schools and private schools are funded in different ways.
Eastern medicine and Western medicine treat pain in distinct ways.
quiet: English follows quite different rules from most other languages.
The Greek idea of justice was debated by many philosophers.
Voters rarely get exactly the policies they ask for.
Physics describes the atom with remarkable precision.
This method of farming has many critics in the region.
Cats face many risks when they are left alone.
Schools are funded in different ways across the country.
Medicine treats pain in many distinct ways today.

short: second side of A-X and B-X contrast
notes: Low confidence; card peaks are on the repeated noun or the second modifier.
